title: Act: Add anchorFor and report canvas rect and zoom from PhaserHost
summary: Create the pure anchor function and expose canvas rect and zoom on resize.
description: Add frontend/src/lib/anchor.ts exporting anchorFor and have PhaserHost report its canvas rect and zoom through an optional onLayout callback on mount, resize and DPR change.
acceptance_criteria: anchorFor returns top-centre and bottom-centre CSS-pixel points from position, bounds, scale, zoom, offset and DPR
PhaserHost calls onLayout with {left, top, zoom, dpr} after every applyZoom

steps.action: Create exported type AnchorInput {position:{x:number;y:number}; bounds?:{x:number;y:number;width:number;height:number}; scale:number; zoom:number; offset:{left:number;top:number}; dpr:number} and function anchorFor(input) returning {top:{x,y}; bottom:{x,y}} in CSS pixels or null when bounds is undefined. cssZoom = zoom / dpr; top.x = offset.left + (position.x + (bounds.x + bounds.width/2)*scale)*cssZoom; top.y = offset.top + (position.y + bounds.y*scale)*cssZoom; bottom.y uses bounds.y+bounds.height.

Add optional prop onLayout?: (l:{left:number;top:number;zoom:number;dpr:number})=>void to PhaserHostProps. After the initial createGame call and at the end of applyZoom, read container.getBoundingClientRect() and call onLayout?.({left:r.left, top:r.top, zoom:currentZoom(), dpr:window.devicePixelRatio}).
steps.code: onLayout?.({ left: r.left, top: r.top, zoom: currentZoom(), dpr: window.devicePixelRatio });
